subject: Parkside Health: temporary PO carve-out for integration pilot
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@parksidehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: parkside-procurement@parksidehealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the team at Parkside is excited to move the 8-week integration pilot forward. Procurement asked me one quick question before I send our vendor intake packet: do you require a formal purchase order for pilot invoices, or is there a short-term invoice-only path we can use while we validate integration and usage?

Budget for the pilot is $18,000 and we expect a single invoice at go-live. We can complete your vendor form and share SOC evidence if that helps accelerate setup.

Attaching the SOW we discussed.

[Attachment: Parkside_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)]

Appreciate any guidance — we want to avoid procurement back-and-forth delaying the kickoff.

Best,
Elena Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
Parkside Health
elena.torres@parksidehealth.com
(415) 555-0127
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@parksidehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Elena — great to hear the team is ready. Short answer: we generally prefer PO-backed invoices, but we do have an exception path for short pilots under $25k (invoice-only) if certain evidence and guardrails are met.

To keep this moving, can you do the following by Monday:
- Send completed vendor intake (names, billing address, tax id) — you can attach or use a shared sheet.
- Confirm SOC2 or provide the security questionnaire answers we requested in the demo packet.
- Confirm billing contact and email for the invoice.

If you provide those items we can onboard Parkside on an invoice-only basis for the pilot and set a strict purchasing timebox (one invoice, 8-week term). Karthik and Naomi are copied to help with the intake + evidence review.

I attached our internal criteria checklist for temporary no-PO pilots so you know what we validate. Once internal approvals are done we can send a one-page addendum (DocuSign) that captures the invoice-only commitment and indemnities.

[Attachment: Redwood_temp-no-po-criteria.pdf]

Next steps: Elena to send intake + evidence; Karthik/Naomi to triage. I’ll follow up if we need leadership sign-off.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Phone: (650) 555-0199

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Parkside pilot — request for temporary invoice-only exception (sub-$25k)

Team — forwarding Parkside’s ask (attached SOW). They’re requesting an invoice-only path for an $18k, single-invoice, 8-week pilot. I preliminarily confirmed we have an exception lane for pilots < $25k when:
- vendor intake completed,
- SOC2 or equivalent evidence provided,
- one-invoice limit and timebox are contractually captured,
- finance flags (AR terms) are acceptable to Billing.

Can we fast-track this? Naomi — can you triage the intake and security evidence this afternoon? Priya — if intake and evidence look good, I’m requesting your approval for a temporary PO carve-out and DocuSign addendum for this pilot.

I’ve attached the Parkside SOW and included our checklist. If there’s anything missing I’ll circle back to Elena.

Thanks,
Rishi

[Quoted message and attachments omitted]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Parkside pilot — request for temporary invoice-only exception (sub-$25k)

Appreciate the summary. I reviewed the checklist and the SOW — looks like a standard low-risk integration pilot. Approve the temporary invoice-only carve-out with these conditions:
- Single invoice only (no recurring bill until formal contract and PO)
- Payment due Net 30 from invoice receipt; AR to confirm and flag if problem
- Parkside sign the Redwood pilot addendum via DocuSign capturing the timebox and liability clauses
- Naomi to confirm SOC2 or compensating controls before addendum is sent

Rishi — you can communicate approval to Elena and request the completed vendor form. Karthik/Naomi — notify Billing to expect an invoice and flag the AR term in the customer record.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Procurement & Vendor Strategy
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com
